reason: I work full time and it's really just Saturdays, so we'd maybe go once or twice a month. At $12 a visit that's cheaper than a $59 membership, so I'd skip the membership and see how it goes.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, which isn't enough to justify a membership. It's also new and unproven, so I'd want to see how the place actually is before paying anything up front.
would_change_my_mind: A cheap 4 or 5 visit punch pass that doesn't expire quickly, or Saturday hours with a free first visit so I can try it.
